other_items.note: STRUCTURAL. Amplitude scales as 1/(omega*C) and this world's year is half Earth's, so 50 m damps seasonality about twice as hard as Earth's ocean does. Coldest-month mean is what PFT survival gates on. One perturbation run, ever, gives a permanent scaling for every later result.

other_items.item: Penman over a dry land column
other_items.note: Validated over ocean, where the air is equilibrated with the surface. Over a subgrid lake the column is dry, so VPD is too high, E is overstated and the verdict under-carves. Opposite in sign to the albedo-driven over-carve, and the only item here whose magnitude is unknown.

stopping_rule: Refine an input when its plausible range exceeds the effect of the thing you last refined.
